reviews.reviewType: Fable OAuth read-only static review; packet follow-up completed. No local tests run.

materialFindings.origin: Current-main integration conflict introduced by #426 after the PR merge base.
materialFindings.evidence: Main #426 has a different plan at the same path and explicitly says it supersedes the draft on #423. Main records the first read-only diagnosis slice as implemented on a branch, and corrects status recheck as potentially writing late effects. PR text still says proposal-only / slice 1 planned. GitHub marks #423 conflicting.
materialFindings.recommendedAction: When resolving, retain the current-main plan verbatim; update PR runbook/open-items proposal wording and label the review note as referring to the superseded draft; rerun relevant doc gates on the integrated head.

materialFindings.origin: Pre-existing code gap; new coverage claim in this PR.
materialFindings.evidence: The audit says Phase I/II summarization is covered, but unchanged Phase I Dynamics summarize consumes response text without checking refusal metadata and writes it to akoya_request.wmkf_ai_summary, marking the run completed. A refusal with nonempty text can cross this durable-write path.
materialFindings.recommendedAction: Guard the llm.complete result and test refusal causes no update/completed audit, or narrow the audit and keep this service as an explicit Sonnet-admission blocker.

materialFindings.origin: Pre-existing code gap; new coverage claim in this PR.
materialFindings.evidence: The report claims Explorer handles refusal as terminal. Root independently verified the batch adapter returns only text/usage from the LLM helper, dropping refusal metadata; the export path parses text and has retry behavior. The chat tool-loop evidence does not cover this separate export path.
materialFindings.recommendedAction: Guard the batch adapter and avoid retry on model_refusal, or narrow the report to the chat loop and state export is not assessed.

materialFindings.origin: New in PR; public visibility verified by root.
materialFindings.evidence: The new committed report includes literal sender and personal iCloud email addresses; repository visibility is PUBLIC. The report elsewhere uses role descriptions, so literals are unnecessary for its evidence claim.
materialFindings.recommendedAction: Replace with role descriptions. Decide whether to rewrite/squash the PR branch history so literals do not become part of main history.

assessedNoMaterialFinding: Thinking-history compaction preservation is technically coherent and the documented token/context trade-off is acceptable for current scope; re-evaluate context-limit behavior before enabling Sonnet overrides.

reviewEvidence.independentCurrentMainCheck: origin/main contains #426 at 31a432de; exact plan path is superseded and repository reports PR #423 conflicting.
